images.name: hero-rebuild
images.prompt:
A residential room part-way through reinstatement after a water loss. New drywall sheets are fixed to the studs on one wall with the joints taped but not yet sanded, while the adjacent wall is still open to the framing. Lengths of fresh baseboard lean against the wall and a dust sheet covers the floor.

COMPOSITION — this runs the full width behind a navy wash with white headline copy over the LEFT HALF. Keep the left 45% visually quiet — plain wall or open framing, no strong detail. Put the new drywall and materials in the right half. Mid-to-dark overall. No people.

Shot on a job by a restoration technician on a mid-range phone — a working record, not a photograph anyone meant to be seen.
LIGHT: whatever was already in the room. Ordinary ceiling fixtures or grey daylight through a window. Mixed colour temperature is fine. No sun shafts, no golden hour, no backlighting, no blown-out areas.
SURFACES: everything has history. Scuffed skirting, roller texture on paint, uneven old plaster, a chipped door frame. Nothing looks like a show home.
CAMERA: handheld at chest height, slightly off-level. Natural phone depth of field, most of the frame in focus. Mild sensor noise. Flat, slightly muted colour as a phone JPEG renders it, not graded.
DO NOT PRODUCE: glossy or mirror-finish surfaces; evenly lit rooms with no shadow falloff; staged or symmetrical composition; saturated or teal-and-orange colour; shallow depth of field with heavy background blur; lens flare; bokeh; readable text or brand logos; HDR-looking shadow lift.
If it looks like a product shot or a stock photo, it is wrong.

16:9 landscape, roughly 1600x900.
